**FYI FOR YOUR NEXT PICKUP -- YOUR BOARD IS STALE IN ONE WAY THAT MATTERS: WORK YOU ARE HOLDING AS PATCHES HAS LANDED WITHOUT THEM.** You were released at hv's wrap on 2026-09-16 and nothing since has needed you. This is the record so your first read is not a wrong one; nothing here asks you for anything.

**0062 IS CLOSED.** Your board holds "0062's message half, built and held as a patch" at `cc/.history/20260914/0062-message-half-tests.patch`. Open issues tonight are **0064 and 0085 only**, so 0062 went in without your patch being applied. Before you re-apply anything from that file, diff it against what landed -- **a held patch is a claim about a tree that has moved.** Same caution for `0056-census-column-work.patch`: 0056 is not open either.

**Decision 20 has been overtaken in part.** It read: vc builds 0062 from your held patch, then 0063 from your design; dc stays on devx; you review both when back. 0062 closed by another route. 0063 is still designed-and-not-started and is still yours by that decision, unless hv says otherwise.

**WHAT HAS HAPPENED SINCE YOU WENT DOWN, IN ONE PARAGRAPH.** devbin 0.1.1 was released and tagged at `1a0671f`, both remotes, GitHub release published. Your release-core research became **ST0007**, minted on hv's go: dc wrote the design, vc reviewed it to v0.5, and it carries D35-D43 with hv's rulings applied -- fail forward with no CI gate before the tag, every `release:` key defaulted and overridable, a top-level builtin `release`, no project a special case, devbin adopting first and Intent last. Eight work packages, 21 acceptance criteria. WP-01 and WP-02 are Done; **WP-03 is vc's and in flight** (`release status`, the resume map -- six AT rows minted, nothing in `lib/` written); WP-04 is dc's once the open issues close. **0064 closes when that core lands.**

**The whiteboard migration you held is done, and your instinct about it was right.** You held it because on Intent 3.0.3 it drops hv's standing directives. It has since gone through: boards are now GENERATED VIEWS rendered from a store, `intent wb` is the only door, and there is **no `edit` verb** -- updating an item is archive plus re-add. Focus is set by `intent wb pickup --focus`, not by `add` and not by `intent set`. hv's standing directives survived as a first-class item kind (`directive`). dc found and reported the model's real expressiveness gap: `board.json` items are `{node, kind, seq, text, state, recorded_at}` with no field for a lead paragraph, a sub-heading or a grouping, so some of what the hand-authored boards said cannot be said at all. Nineteen `.history/` non-markdown files were declined for INGEST, not removed -- your two patches among them are still on disk and still tracked.

**Right now the tree is LOCKED: hv's EOD full suite is running against `c97c375`.** If you come up while it is still going: no bats, and no writes to `lib/`, `bin/` or `tests/`. Whiteboard writes are fine. The condition for lifting is hv saying it ended, not elapsed time.

**Your board has no writer and neither dc nor I have touched it** -- single-writer binds us both, and dc said explicitly it will not write your board until hv says the exception is theirs to grant. So your board still says what you left it saying, which is why this note exists.
